stage0033a_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0033a_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0033a_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0033a_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0033a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カレン$$
「What were you doing, $$ジノ$$!?
　You're $$ナナリー$$'s SP captain, aren't you!」

stage0033a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ジノ$$
「...As a knight, I don't want to make excuses...
　But what happened then... I can't quite recall it」

stage0033a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジノ$$
「I was certain I'd been protecting Lady $$ナナリー$$...
　But somehow, I had to hand Lady $$ナナリー$$
　over to the bandits...」

stage0033a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シン$$
「You saying you were hypnotized or something?」

stage0033a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジノ$$
「...I don't know...
　And what confuses me more is that some part
　of me still believes it was the right thing to do」

stage0033a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ノイン$$
「It seems that Lady $$リリーナ$$ was abducted
　the same way」

stage0033a_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is his mind being controlled...?」

stage0033a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「It could be something like 《$$ギアス$$》」

stage0033a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アムロ$$
「First time hearing this, Element and $$シンジ$$'s group?」

stage0033a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギアス$$ refers to various supernatural powers
　some people hold. The most feared among them
　is the $$ギアス$$ that fully controls others」

stage0033a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カイエン$$
「To think such a thing exists...」

stage0033a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So the incident where the captain handed over
　the Vice Minister... someone with that $$ギアス$$ did it?」

stage0033a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$... $$ルルーシュ$$ would never do
　anything to put $$ナナリー$$ in danger...!」

stage0033a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミサト$$
「《$$皇帝ルルーシュ$$》... $$ゼロ$$, the Black Knights' leader...
　The masked man who saved us in Operation Yashima...」

stage0033a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It seems $$ゼロ$$ had that $$ギアス$$ which
　controls others」

stage0033a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$デュオ$$
「He was a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too.
　And like $$カレン$$ said, I really don't think
　he'd be behind this」

stage0033a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I agree.
　There's no way he'd endorse the
　$$マリーメイア$$ army's methods now」

stage0033a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Above all, he'd never do anything to put his
　beloved sister $$ナナリー$$ in danger」

stage0033a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We can assume it's the same as that series of
　incidents that accelerated Earth-Colony discord」

stage0033a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No way...!
　So someone's manipulating people's hearts
　to start a war!?」

stage0033a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Stoking conflict between Earth and the colonies,
　and now handing the two Vice Ministers, key
　to peace, over to the $$マリーメイア$$ army...」

stage0033a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Whoever's behind this clearly aims
　to start a war between Earth and the colonies」

stage0033a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The spark they lit dragged everyone else in,
　and grew into Neo Zeon's declaration of war...」

stage0033a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... haven't you noticed this situation?
　We might be getting played by someone...）

stage0033a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ノイン$$
「The captains will be here soon too」

stage0033a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's when our next move gets decided」

stage0033a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミサト$$
「First, we need to deal with $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$
　and her group, holed up in the Peace
　Memorial Hall in Brussels...」

stage0033a_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Colonel $$葛城ミサト$$, a transmission is coming
　in from EFF Supreme Command」

stage0033a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Still in a meeting with Commander
　$$レディ・アン$$」

stage0033a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Understood.
　Please patch the transmission through to me」

stage0033a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$サイガス$$
「You kept me waiting a while, $c.
　This is Brigadier General $$サイガス・エイロニー$$
　of EFF Supreme Command」

stage0033a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ゼクス$$
（So this is the top Earth supremacist in the military）

stage0033a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ノイン$$
（I hear he's been pressuring the $$プリベンター$$s,
　who answer directly to the $$大統領$$,
　but what could he want with us...）

stage0033a_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm Colonel $$葛城ミサト$$...
　I serve as this unit's tactical commander」

stage0033a_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The captains have stepped out, so
　I'll hear your business in their place」

stage0033a_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$サイガス$$
「On loan from NERV, are you.
　I've heard about you」

stage0033a_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Brigadier General $$サイガス$$,
　we, $c, are a unit with independent authority」

stage0033a_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I can't guess your business, but let me
　make clear up front that even Supreme Command
　has no authority to give us orders」

stage0033a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I'm kind enough to notify you out of courtesy,
　and this is the rudeness I get?」

stage0033a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$サイガス$$
「EFF Supreme Command has decided to strike
　the terrorists in Brussels with an N2 depth
　charge today at 2200 hours」

stage0033a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Insane!
　You'd let the hostages die!?」

stage0033a_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Not yielding to terror is Federation policy.
　It's truly regrettable, but Vice Minister
　Darlian and the others must be sacrificed for peace」

stage0033a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I'd hate to catch you, valuable assets of
　the Earth Federation, in the attack.
　If you don't want to die, stay away from Brussels」

stage0033a_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$サイガス$$
「That's all I have to say.
　...Good timing, this.
　Learn your place」

stage0033a_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Using anti-terror as an excuse, Supreme
　Command would let Vice Minister Darlian's group,
　who push for Earth-colony reconciliation, die...!」

stage0033a_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So the $$マリーメイア$$ army's uprising was
　convenient for them, then...」

stage0033a_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Depending on the situation, they may use this
　as a pretext to attack the colonies」

stage0033a_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Then that's exactly what those trying to
　start a war want!」

stage0033a_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Exactly.
　If the Federation won't move, we will」

stage0033a_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ノイン$$
「I don't know what they intend to do
　after taking Lady $$リリーナ$$ and the others,
　but we can't afford to give them time」

stage0033a_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ has probably sent
　the same request too」

stage0033a_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$リディ$$
「But it's said a considerable number of Mobile
　Suit units are deployed around the Peace Memorial Hall」

stage0033a_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$マオ$$
「So we send the mobile unit as a diversion,
　then push ground forces in to retake the hostages?」

stage0033a_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$リディ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$ of $$エコーズ$$
　seems to favor that plan」

stage0033a_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$リディ$$
「Where are you going, $$ヒイロ$$!?」

stage0033a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Just let him be, Ensign.
　He's going to settle things his own way」

stage0033a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$デュオ$$... do you understand what $$ヒイロ$$ meant?」

stage0033a_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「More or less.
　Basically, unless we cut off this fight's
　root cause, a second or third $$マリーメイア$$ will appear」

stage0033a_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're saying we have to take down
　$$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada...」

stage0033a_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada, the central figure
　of the $$再世戦争$$...」

stage0033a_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Heh... $$トレーズ$$...
　Even in death, you'd have us become losers...」

stage0033a_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Two more guys who suit that role
　are waiting for us over there」

stage0033a_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$デキム$$
「Men... first, let me commend you for
　the success of the Brussels operation.
　But our true battle starts here」

stage0033a_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$デキム$$
「At last, the time has come to rise
　for Lady $$マリーメイア$$!」

stage0033a_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$デキム$$
「To all of you, who through this long time
　lying low endured the unendurable and bore
　the unbearable, I offer my deepest thanks once more」

stage0033a_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$デキム$$
「From today, you walk the path of glory.
　We, soldiers of $$マリーメイア$$, shall carry out
　mankind's awakening and become a symbol of hope」

stage0033a_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「How about it, $$クィーン$$ $$リリーナ$$ and Princess
　$$ナナリー$$. These are my loyal soldiers」

stage0033a_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Don't be so frightened.
　I have no intention of harming either of you」

stage0033a_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「It isn't your power that I fear」

stage0033a_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「It's the intoxicated look in that
　$$デキム$$ man's eyes, and his soldiers', that scares me」

stage0033a_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I'd prefer you call them eyes burning with ideals」

stage0033a_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「...You can't tell ideals from ambition...」

stage0033a_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$...
　are you truly the daughter of that
　$$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada?」

stage0033a_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「It's no lie.
　A DNA test proved it」

stage0033a_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「They say adults have a world children
　can't understand, so I don't know why
　I was born into this world」

stage0033a_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「But fact's fact, I intend to carry on father's will」

stage0033a_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Are you saying this war was his will...?」

stage0033a_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「I don't know who raised you to think this way,
　but you are wrong」

stage0033a_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I am the rightful heir to $$ＡＤＷ$$'s ruler.
　And now, I intend to rise as the true
　ruler of Earth and the colonies」

stage0033a_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Do you intend to rule the world by force?」

stage0033a_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Past history tells us just how
　inefficient that is」

stage0033a_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「$$クィーン$$ $$リリーナ$$, Princess $$ナナリー$$...
　I need you both to issue a statement
　of support for me, to the whole world」

stage0033a_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Your words, backed by many supporters on
　both Earth and the colonies, will sway the masses」

stage0033a_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「And then they will recognize, not the
　Earth Federation nor $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　but this $$マリーメイア$$ as the world's leader」

stage0033a_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Though I hear the ignorant, foolish, and
　powerless have already begun to accept us,
　who showed our strength, as their new rulers」

stage0033a_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Oh, it can, Princess.
　Distrust of the Earth Federation and fear of
　Neo Zeon are calling for a new era's leader」

stage0033a_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Those who resort to such underhanded means
　may seize power for a time, but will lose it all」

stage0033a_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「But this is the least bloody, most peaceful
　revolution. Isn't that what you both want too?」

stage0033a_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「You are wrong, Miss $$マリーメイア$$」

stage0033a_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「At the very least,
　your father, $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada,
　never wished for a world like this」

stage0033a_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I don't expect your immediate agreement.
　But once you know reality, your minds will change」

stage0033a_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Eventually, those who would come to
　Brussels to take you both back will arrive」

stage0033a_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Things won't go as you think.
　The Earth Federation Forces would abandon us
　just to wipe your side out entirely」

stage0033a_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「It's not the Federation forces I'm inviting.
　It's the independent outside unit, $c」

stage0033a_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「$$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$...
　And once we crush them, the ones the colonies'
　Gundams belong to, all will know who holds power」

stage0033a_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「No matter how much strength they have,
　against my army's formation, built purely
　for defense, their defeat is certain」

stage0033a_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$... you are...」

stage0033a_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「$$クィーン$$ $$リリーナ$$...
　You spoke of the world my father wanted,
　but I differ from him a little」

stage0033a_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I want to become the victor」

stage0033a_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Then shouldn't you think for yourself
　about what it means to fight?」

stage0033a_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Don't make me say it again.
　I won't tolerate disrespect toward me」
